title: Bug reports
source: P145 B1 (decision 0054): a core database for every project kind, required by none. Created beside Clients by `hub install --only notion.bug-reports`; the agent files into it through the Hub tool `bug_report` only. Data source ids are not carried and are NOT portable.

Bug.description: The symptom in one line, in the client's terms. Written by the Hub's bug_report tool; people may edit.
Bug.note: Never a cause: a cause is people's, in Notes.

Projects.description: The project keys this report belongs to (decision 0053), the same options as Clients Projects.
Projects.note: Options are the `## Brands` rows; `notion.projects` keeps them in step.

Clients.description: Every client who reported this bug. A second client with the same symptom is added here, never filed again.
Clients.note: Several; one-way (Clients gets no reverse property).

Source link.description: Where the first report was made: the conversation in the Hub admin. Written by the tool from the conversation, never typed by the agent.

Client's words.description: The client's own sentence, quoted (at most 1,500 characters). Later reports are appended to the page body, dated.

Evidence.description: One line per URL, id or screenshot reference the client gave. Only what the client sent or the agent saw.

Kind.description: Product: our product misbehaves. Knowledge gap: a client asked what the knowledge base does not answer (or only in general). Workflow: the agent could not resolve something itself (a refusal with no path, a lead it could not classify, a missing or contradictory record). Empty is Product.
Kind.note: P147 3g. The open-report search keys on Kind plus Area, so a recurring gap is one row with many Clients.

Area.description: <kind>: <name>, lower case (parser: <source>, site: <domain>, api, admin; for a Knowledge gap the topic, knowledge: <topic>; for Workflow the step, workflow: <tool or step>). An option is reused when its normalised form matches.
Area.note: The open-report search keys on Area and Projects.

Status.description: The agent sets New only; people move it on. A select, not a Status: the API cannot create a Status.
Status.note: Fixed with an empty Client told makes the follow-up sweep propose a "fixed" message (B4, after P142).

Severity.description: Set by people at triage; empty until then. The agent never writes it.

Duplicate of.description: The report this one repeats (Status Duplicate).

Reported at.description: When the first report's message was sent.

Last reported.description: When the latest report was appended.

Client told.description: When the clients were told it is fixed: set by the Hub at the send of the "fixed" message. Do not edit.

Fix link.description: The commit, pull request or task that fixed it.

Notes.description: People's notes, the cause among them. The agent never writes here.
